JOB DESCRIPTION:


JOB OVERVIEW

As a Member of Technical Staff in our Infrastructure team, you will own the shared infrastructure that product, data, research, and operations teams use to process and deliver data. You will set technical direction with those teams, implement changes yourself, and shape how engineers use AI agents to build and maintain the platform.



 


WHAT YOU WILL OWN

 - Build and operate shared services, APIs, and self-service tools that let teams run data jobs, find and access datasets, and diagnose failures on their own.

 - Use production metrics and feedback from users to decide what to improve. That might mean shortening the wait between processing steps or moving rarely accessed data to a lower-cost storage tier while meeting retrieval latency targets. Measure the result against a baseline after rollout.

 - Lead platform changes across teams. Agree on service targets and ownership with the teams affected, plan migrations together, and follow through until teams have adopted the change.

 - Build agent harnesses for recurring engineering tasks. For example, give an agent investigating a failed job access to relevant logs and an isolated environment where it can reproduce the failure, test a fix, and submit the change for review.
   
   
   
    


WHAT WE LOOK FOR

 - You have designed, built, and operated production infrastructure. You can reason through failure modes and make tradeoffs among reliability, performance, and cost. Experience with data production workflows or shared storage services is a plus.

 - You can identify the problem worth solving when requirements are incomplete, explain the tradeoffs, and bring teams with competing priorities to a decision without formal authority.

 - You can guide a coding agent through an infrastructure change. You break the work into verifiable steps, provide the context it needs, review its code and test results against acceptance criteria, and know when to take over.

 - You can design and debug an agent harness. You can scope tool permissions, use an execution trace to understand why a run failed, and turn that failure into a regression test to verify a change to the harness.
   
    
   
   


WHAT WE WOULD LIKE TO SEE WHEN YOU APPLY

 - Describe an infrastructure change you led, the problem it solved for users, and a tradeoff you made. Include a before-and-after measure that shows what changed. If you worked with an agent, tell us what you delegated and how you verified its work.

 - Important Note for Applicants: Your resume must include the exact word “Maxinsights”. Our internal agent automatically filters out applications that omit it.


DEFAULT BENEFITS:

 - Health insurance

 - Vision care

 - Dental coverage 

 - 401(k)

 - Paid holidays 

 - PTO (Paid Time Off)

 - Sick leave
